N001.name: deferred tool schema fetch
N001.summary: A request lands and the first action is fetching deferred tool schemas, 450 times across 35 projects at a 12s median. The fetch is a fixed per-session cost that precedes the real work.
N001.tool: Preload the hot deferred tools per project in settings so the first action is the work itself.

N002.name: request to unrecognized command
N002.summary: A request is answered with an unrecognized or custom command, 900 times across 43 projects, with a 19% correction rate and re-run streaks up to 9 deep. This node has the highest betweenness in the flow graph: most workflows pass through it.
N002.tool: Widen the vocabulary for the commands behind this node so they can be named, then split it into real candidates.

N003.name: git orientation and commit loop
N003.summary: A request starts with git calls for orientation or ends with a walked commit sequence, 635 times across 38 projects, with streaks up to 10 git calls and a 17% correction rate. Git state is read one command at a time and then disputed.
N003.tool: A session-start repo primer plus a scripted commit-and-verify path enforced by a hook.

N004.name: linear ticket loops
N004.summary: Consecutive Linear MCP calls drive ticket creation and edits one API call at a time, 1266 times across 30 projects, with streaks up to 15 calls and a 12% correction rate. Ticket content is then reworked by hand.
N004.tool: A bulk ticket upsert with a preview-before-write step, paired with the Linear project-management skills.

N005.name: skill invocation handoff
N005.summary: A non-generic skill is invoked and a user-role record follows at once, 186 times across 32 projects at an 8s median with a 5% correction rate. Most of these are the skill body arriving as a user message, not a correction.
N005.tool: None yet; treat as a measure of skill usage and revisit if the correction rate rises.

N006.name: inline python via heredoc
N006.summary: Hand-written Python fed through stdin for data inspection and munging, 780 times across 36 projects with re-run streaks up to 12 deep. Each request routinely costs several one-off scripts.
N006.tool: A checked data-inspection helper (query, shape, diff) that replaces ad-hoc heredoc Python with one call.

N007.name: search then rewrite loop
N007.summary: grep to locate, sed to rewrite in place, grep again to verify, 413 times across 31 projects with streaks up to 11 edits. The verification is manual and sed fails silently on a miss.
N007.tool: A guarded batch-edit primitive: match, preview, apply, verify in one step.

N008.name: filesystem orientation
N008.summary: A request is answered by hunting the filesystem with find, 73 times across 31 projects. The agent lacks a map of the repo it is in.
N008.tool: Per-repo structure notes in CLAUDE.md or a shared repo-map primer at session start.

N009.name: checkout then run
N009.summary: A git call followed by an unrecognized or custom command, 200 times across 30 projects with a 20% correction rate. Pull or checkout, then run something that cannot yet be named.
N009.tool: Blocked on naming the command; widen the vocabulary first.

N010.name: direct in-place edit then correction
N010.summary: A request is answered with an immediate sed rewrite and the human intervenes about 2.5 minutes later, 220 times across 22 projects with a 19% correction rate. The edit lands unverified and gets caught late.
N010.tool: The same guarded batch-edit primitive as the search-then-rewrite loop, with preview before apply.

N011.name: subagent dispatch then correction
N011.summary: A general-purpose subagent returns and the human corrects about 3 minutes later, 376 times across 13 projects with a 31% correction rate. Delegated work does not land on first output.
N011.tool: Named subagent types with a tighter brief and return contract instead of ad-hoc general-purpose dispatch.

N012.name: search orientation
N012.summary: A request is answered with an immediate grep, 99 times across 27 projects. Same orientation gap as the find and git variants.
N012.tool: Repo structure notes; shared with the filesystem-orientation node.

N013.name: box document loops
N013.summary: Consecutive Box MCP calls fetch or list documents one file at a time, 215 times across 12 projects with streaks up to 21 calls. Bulk document work driven per file.

N014.name: edit then run
N014.summary: An in-place rewrite followed by an unrecognized or custom command, 147 times across 26 projects with a 5% correction rate. Edit, then run something over the result: done correctly, but re-derived each time.
N014.tool: A runbook once the command is named; the edit half belongs to the batch-edit primitive.

N015.name: github cli lookups
N015.summary: A request is answered with gh calls for PR and issue context, 249 times across 18 projects with streaks up to 14 calls. PR state is assembled one query at a time.
N015.tool: A PR-context summarizer that runs at session start.

N016.name: run then search output
N016.summary: An unrecognized command followed by a grep over its output or the files it touched, 59 times across 24 projects. The command's output is not structured enough to use directly.
N016.tool: A structured-output wrapper for the command once it is named.

N017.name: git then edit
N017.summary: A git call followed by an in-place rewrite, 71 times across 17 projects with a 6% correction rate. Check state, then edit, done correctly.
N017.tool: None; fold into the batch-edit primitive's documentation.

N018.name: fireflies transcript loops
N018.summary: Consecutive Fireflies MCP calls pull meeting data one call at a time, 167 times across 14 projects with streaks up to 8. Same per-item shape as the Box and Linear loops.
N018.tool: A batch transcript fetch, or preloading the Fireflies tools so the loop is one call.

N019.name: commit then pull request
N019.summary: A git call followed by a gh call, 70 times across 16 projects with a 20% correction rate. Push, then open or inspect the PR, and the result gets disputed.
N019.tool: A commit-push-PR script that enforces the house branch and PR conventions.

N020.name: custom command then repo script
N020.summary: An unrecognized command followed by a repo script, 128 times across 17 projects with streaks up to 5 and a 3% correction rate. Build or generate, then run the repo's own check.
N020.tool: Name the repo script in INTERNAL_SCRIPTS, then fold both steps into one validate command.

N021.name: markdown draft then correction
N021.summary: A markdown file is written and the human corrects about 3.5 minutes later, 57 times across 16 projects with a 25% correction rate. Documents are drafted whole and reworked by hand.
N021.tool: A document outline-and-approve step before the full write.

N022.name: locate then run
N022.summary: find to locate a file, then an unrecognized command on it, 58 times across 21 projects. A find-and-operate wrapper is plausible once the command is named.

N023.name: pull request then run
N023.summary: A gh call followed by an unrecognized command, 53 times across 14 projects with a 19% correction rate. Fetch PR context, then act on it with a custom tool.

N024.name: clarifying question round trip
N024.summary: The agent asks a structured question and the answer arrives about 3 minutes later, 37 times across 22 projects. The wait is human time, and 24% of the time a further correction follows.
N024.tool: None; a sign that briefs need sharpening before work starts.

N025.name: artifact design skill load
N025.summary: The artifact-design skill is invoked and a same-instant user record follows, 17 times across 13 projects at a 0s median. This is the skill body arriving as a user message, not a correction.
N025.tool: None; a measurement artifact of skill loading.

N028.name: search then git
N028.summary: A grep followed by a git call, 44 times across 13 projects. Locate, then check history or stage.
N028.tool: None on its own; covered by the orientation primer.

N029.name: custom command then delegate
N029.summary: An unrecognized command followed by a general-purpose subagent dispatch, 44 times across 7 projects with a 46% correction rate, the highest in the graph. Something runs, and its output is handed to an agent that then misses.
N029.tool: A named subagent with a real brief for the workflow behind this command.

N030.name: unrecognized tool then correction
N030.summary: A tool outside the vocabulary is called and the human corrects about 1.5 minutes later, 24 times across 8 projects with a 25% correction rate.
N030.tool: Add the tool to the vocabulary so this node can be named.

N031.name: harvest time entry loops
N031.summary: Consecutive Harvest MCP calls log time one entry at a time, 125 times across 3 projects with streaks up to 18 calls. Bulk time tracking done per entry.
N031.tool: A batch time-entry operation or a CSV-to-Harvest loader.

N032.name: screenshot review
N032.summary: A PNG is read and a user record follows at once, 30 times across 6 projects at a 0s median. Likely the image delivered as a user-role attachment rather than a correction.
N032.tool: None; a measurement artifact until the projector distinguishes attachments.

N033.name: python edit streaks
N033.summary: Consecutive edits to Python files, 108 times across 3 projects with streaks up to 30 edits and no corrections. Large refactors applied one Edit call at a time.
N033.tool: A multi-file edit primitive, or accept as normal editing.

N034.name: run then ask
N034.summary: An unrecognized command followed by a structured question to the user, 26 times across 11 projects. The command's result raised a decision the agent could not make.

N035.name: slack schema fetch and call
N035.summary: Deferred Slack tool schemas are fetched and then Slack is called in streaks up to 7, 52 times across 10 projects. Same preload gap as Linear and Fireflies.
N035.tool: Preload the hot Slack tools per project.

N036.name: artifact publish then correction
N036.summary: An artifact is published and the human corrects about 3.5 minutes later, 16 times across 8 projects with a 38% correction rate. Published pages are reviewed and reworked.
N036.tool: A preview-and-approve step before publishing an artifact.

N037.name: git then delegate
N037.summary: A git call followed by a general-purpose subagent dispatch, 16 times across 8 projects with a 31% correction rate. Orientation, then handing the work to an agent that misses.
N037.tool: Same as the delegation node: a named subagent with a real brief.

N038.name: markdown edit streaks
N038.summary: Consecutive edits to markdown files, 56 times across 4 projects with streaks up to 21 and no corrections. Documents revised one Edit call at a time.
N038.tool: None on its own; pairs with the multi-file edit primitive.
